spec.scene: A lush grassy hillside slopes gently from back to front, dotted with a pair of slender palm trees at the back right. In the center, two figures sit picnic-style: one in a cream sweater and one in a denim jacket, sharing a halved foil-wrapped burrito on butcher paper. Beside them sits a joyful golden dog clamping an oversized neon yellow tennis ball in his jaws. At the back edge, two tiny figures toss a red disc across the lawn under bright morning sun.
spec.title: Lazy Sunday with Biscuit
spec.caption: Split a burrito on the hill while Biscuit hoarded his tennis ball.
